name: Maserati MC20
description: The Maserati MC20 marks the Italian marque's return to producing mid-engined supercars after two decades. Unveiled in 2020, the MC20 features the revolutionary Nettuno engine, a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged V6 developed entirely in-house using patented pre-chamber combustion technology derived from Formula 1. This innovative powerplant produces 630 hp and 730 Nm of torque, enabling a 0-100 km/h sprint in just 2.9 seconds and a top speed of 325 km/h. The lightweight carbon fiber monocoque chassis weighs just 1,410 kg, resulting in an exceptional power-to-weight ratio of 2.24 kg/hp. With its butterfly doors, elegant Italian design, and advanced aerodynamics, the MC20 combines Maserati's grand touring heritage with genuine supercar performance, establishing a new chapter in the brand's storied motorsport history.
author: Ceky Performance
